arXiv 2025 · 成像逆问题 / 分布偏移检测

测量域的 KL：用扩散模型无监督检测逆问题中的分布偏移

Unsupervised Detection of Distribution Shift in Inverse Problems using Diffusion Models

Shirin Shoushtari · Edward P. Chandler · Yuanhao Wang · M. Salman Asif · Ulugbek S. Kamilov（Washington University in St. Louis / University of California, Riverside）

求解逆问题时，我们手上几乎只有被前向算子破坏过的测量，看不到干净的测试图像。这篇论文证明：只看这些受损测量，加上两个在不同数据上训练好的扩散模型给出的分数函数，就能算出一个等于（或逼近）图像域 KL 散度的量。作者把投影算子引进 KL 的 de Bruijn 恒等式，得到带权重的测量域度量，并在修复（inpainting）与 MRI 欠采样上验证它紧跟干净图像算出的 KL；随后用同一个度量做轻量适配，把 OOD 模型的分数函数拉向 InD，重建指标随之变好。

读之前，先看清这条链路

这一段是译者注，不是原文。它只做一件事：让你在读到公式 (1)–(9) 时，知道每个量在做什么、为什么「测量域」能等于「图像域」。

  1. 两个分布：InD 密度 p(x)p(\boldsymbol{x})p(x) 是训练（测试时想要的）图像分布，OOD 密度 q(x)q(\boldsymbol{x})q(x) 是另一个数据集。两个扩散模型分别学到它们的分数函数 ∇log⁡pσ(xσ)\nabla\log p_{\sigma}(\boldsymbol{x}_{\sigma})∇logpσ​(xσ​) 与 ∇log⁡qσ(xσ)\nabla\log q_{\sigma}(\boldsymbol{x}_{\sigma})∇logqσ​(xσ​)。
  2. KL 的 de Bruijn 形式：公式 (4) 把 DKL(p∥q)D_{\mathrm{KL}}(p\|q)DKL​(p∥q) 写成一串噪声层级上的分数差平方的积分。它只需要分数函数，不需要密度本身——这正是扩散模型能提供的东西。
  3. 为什么不能直接用：公式 (4) 的期望在干净图像 x\boldsymbol{x}x 上取（xσ∼p(xσ∣x)\boldsymbol{x}_{\sigma}\sim p(\boldsymbol{x}_{\sigma}\mid\boldsymbol{x})xσ​∼p(xσ​∣x)）。逆问题里没有 x\boldsymbol{x}x，只有 y=Hx+z\boldsymbol{y}=\mathbf{H}\boldsymbol{x}+\boldsymbol{z}y=Hx+z。
  4. SVD 解耦：对 H=UΣVT\mathbf{H}=\boldsymbol{U}\boldsymbol{\Sigma}\boldsymbol{V}^{\mathsf{T}}H=UΣVT 做变量替换，测量在 V\boldsymbol{V}V 坐标下变成「被对角投影矩阵 P\boldsymbol{P}P 挑出部分坐标」。于是分数函数可以在测量坐标上求值：∇log⁡pσ(Vy‾σ)\nabla\log p_{\sigma}(\boldsymbol{V}\overline{\boldsymbol{y}}_{\sigma})∇logpσ​(Vy​σ​)。
  5. 权重 W\boldsymbol{W}W：不同 P\boldsymbol{P}P 保留的坐标不同，某些坐标被观测到的概率低。取 W=E[P]−3/2\boldsymbol{W}=\mathbb{E}[\boldsymbol{P}]^{-3/2}W=E[P]−3/2 正好抵消投影带来的偏差，使期望回到图像域的 ∥∇log⁡p−∇log⁡q∥22\|\nabla\log p-\nabla\log q\|_2^2∥∇logp−∇logq∥22​。
  6. 能算的量：实际计算用积分到某个噪声层级 σ\sigmaσ 的截断值（图的纵轴就是这个截断 KL），离散求和代替积分。
术语速查（译者注）
分数函数 score
对数密度的梯度 ∇log⁡p\nabla\log p∇logp；扩散模型用 Tweedie 公式把它和去噪器等价起来。
去噪器 Dσ\mathsf{D}_{\sigma}Dσ​
MMSE 意义下的后验均值估计 E[x∣xσ]\mathbb{E}[\boldsymbol{x}\mid\boldsymbol{x}_{\sigma}]E[x∣xσ​]；与分数只差一个 σ2\sigma^{2}σ2。
前向算子 / 测量算子 H\mathbf{H}H
把图像变成测量的线性算子。修复里是随机置零的对角掩膜，MRI 里是部分傅里叶采样。
P=Σ†Σ\boldsymbol{P}=\boldsymbol{\Sigma}^{\dagger}\boldsymbol{\Sigma}P=Σ†Σ
取值只有 0/1 的对角投影矩阵，表示「这个坐标被观测到了没有」。
InD / OOD
分布内（这里是训练与测试同分布的那一侧）/ 分布外。
Adapt64 / Adapt128
用 64 / 128 条来自 InD 的投影（受损）测量对 OOD 模型做微调后的版本。

摘要

English original
Abstract

扩散模型被广泛用作成像逆问题中的先验。然而，当训练图像与测试图像之间存在分布偏移时，它们的性能往往会退化。现有的识别与量化分布偏移的方法通常需要干净的测试图像，而在求解逆问题（测试时）几乎从不可能拿到这类图像。我们提出一个完全无监督的度量，仅使用间接（受损）测量，以及由在不同数据集上训练的扩散模型给出的分数函数，来估计分布偏移。我们从理论上证明，该度量估计的是训练图像分布与测试图像分布之间的 KL 散度。在实验上，我们展示这个只使用受损测量的、基于分数的度量，能够很好地逼近由干净图像计算出的 KL 散度。受此结果启发，我们进一步展示：仅使用受损测量，把分布外的分数与分布内的分数对齐，可以降低 KL 散度，并在多个逆问题上带来更好的重建质量。

English original
Diffusion models are widely used as priors in imaging inverse problems. However, their performance often degrades under distribution shifts between the training and test-time images. Existing methods for identifying and quantifying distribution shifts typically require access to clean test images, which are almost never available while solving inverse problems (at test time). We propose a fully unsupervised metric for estimating distribution shifts using only indirect (corrupted) measurements and score functions from diffusion models trained on different datasets. We theoretically show that this metric estimates the KL divergence between the training and test image distributions. Empirically, we show that our score-based metric, using only corrupted measurements, closely approximates the KL divergence computed from clean images. Motivated by this result, we show that aligning the out-of-distribution score with the in-distribution score—using only corrupted measurements—reduces the KL divergence and leads to improved reconstruction quality across multiple inverse problems.

1 引言

English original
1 Introduction

标准的深度学习模型通常假设训练数据与测试数据来自同一分布。然而这一假设经常不成立 [1]，分布外（OOD）的测试输入会造成显著的性能退化——在医疗与机器人等领域尤其如此 [2]。因此，检测并量化分布偏移对构建稳健模型是必需的。近期工作关注刻画分布偏移 [3, 4, 5] 以及检测 OOD 样本 [6]（另见综述 [7, 2]）。一种被广泛使用的 OOD 检测策略基于模型置信度：以 softmax 为基础的指标——例如最大概率偏低或熵偏高——作为检测分布偏移的简单而有效的代理，尤其适用于分类任务 [8, 9]。

English original
Standard deep learning models typically assume that training and test data are drawn from the same distribution. However, this assumption often fails [1], with out-of-distribution (OOD) test inputs causing significant performance degradation—specially in domains like healthcare and robotics [2]. Detecting and quantifying distribution shifts is thus essential for building robust models. Recent works have focused on characterizing distribution shifts [3, 4, 5] and detecting OOD samples [6] (see also reviews in [7, 2]). A widely used strategy for OOD detection is based on model confidence, where softmax-based indicators—such as low maximum probability or high entropy—serve as simple yet effective proxies for detecting distribution shifts, especially in classification tasks [8, 9].

扩散模型（DM）[10, 11] 已被证明在广泛的任务上达到最先进性能，包括高质量图像生成 [12, 13, 14, 15, 16]、成像逆问题 [17, 18] 与医学成像 [19, 20, 21, 22, 23]（另见近期综述 [24, 25, 26, 27]）。这些模型逼近数据分布的分数函数，并通过随机微分方程实现有原理的采样 [11]，从而能从纯噪声生成数据。由于扩散模型通过学到的分数函数逼近整个数据分布，它们天然对分布偏移敏感，需要高效的 OOD 检测与偏移量化方法。近期工作通过分析各种基于扩散模型的途径来探索这一点，包括分数一致性、样本似然、重建误差以及扩散轨迹的性质 [28, 29, 30, 31]。

English original
Diffusion models (DMs) [10, 11] have been shown to achieve state-of-the-art performance across a wide range of tasks, including high-quality image generation [12, 13, 14, 15, 16], imaging inverse problems [17, 18], and medical imaging [19, 20, 21, 22, 23] (see also recent reviews [24, 25, 26, 27]). These models approximate the score function of the data distribution and enable principled sampling via stochastic differential equations [11], allowing data generation from pure noise. Since diffusion models approximate the full data distribution through learned score functions, they are inherently sensitive to distribution shifts and require efficient methods for OOD detection and shift quantification. Recent work has explored this by analyzing various diffusion model-based approaches, including score consistency, sample likelihood, reconstruction error, and properties of the diffusion trajectory [28, 29, 30, 31].

现有 OOD 检测方法的一个关键局限是依赖干净的测试图像。此外，近期利用扩散模型的方法主要关注 OOD 样本的二分类检测，而不是量化分布偏移的程度 [28, 29, 30, 31]。在许多应用（例如逆问题）中，只有间接（受损）测量可用，获得干净的基准真值图像并不现实。为填补这一空白，我们提出首个无监督度量，仅使用受损测量来估计在分布内（InD）数据与 OOD 数据上训练的扩散模型之间的分布偏移。在对测量算子明确陈述的假设下，我们证明该度量估计的是底层图像分布之间的 KL 散度。在修复与 MRI 重建上的实验结果表明，我们的度量虽然只作用于受损测量，却能在多种数据集与破坏程度下很好地逼近用干净图像算出的图像域 KL 散度。图 1 展示了这一行为：在掩膜概率 p∈{0.2,0.5,0.8}p\in\{0.2,0.5,0.8\}p∈{0.2,0.5,0.8} 的修复破坏下，用 FFHQ 训练的 InD 模型，与用 MetFaces、AFHQ、Microscopy 训练的 OOD 模型之间，所提出的测量域 KL 度量与用干净图像算出的 KL 散度的对比。

English original
A key limitation of existing OOD detection methods is their reliance on clean test-time images. Moreover, recent methods that leverage diffusion models primarily focus on binary detection of OOD samples, rather than quantifying the degree of distribution shift [28, 29, 30, 31]. In many applications, such as inverse problems, only indirect (corrupted) measurements are available, and access to clean ground-truth images is unrealistic. To address this gap, we propose the first unsupervised metric for estimating the distribution shift between diffusion models trained on in-distribution (InD) and OOD data, using only corrupted measurements. Under clearly stated assumptions on the measurement operator, we prove that the proposed metric estimates the KL divergence between the underlying image distributions. Empirical results on inpainting and MRI reconstruction demonstrate that our metric, while operating solely on corrupted measurements, closely approximates the image-domain KL divergence computed from clean images, across a variety of datasets and corruption levels. Figure 1 illustrates this behavior, comparing our proposed measurement-domain KL metric with the KL divergence computed using clean images, under inpainting corruption with masking probabilities p ∈ {0.2, 0.5, 0.8}, using an InD model trained on FFHQ and OOD models trained on MetFaces, AFHQ, and Microscopy.

域适配方法旨在缓解训练数据与测试数据之间的分布偏移 [32]，在更广泛的机器学习文献中已有充分研究 [33, 34]。然而在逆问题中，由于拿不到干净的测试时数据，适配尤其困难。近期的自监督方法探索了仅使用测量域信号来适配深度学习模型 [35, 36, 37]，但这些方法很大程度上是启发式的，缺少对其有效性的理论论证。我们的度量提供了一个有原理的框架，把分布偏移形式化地联系到在受损测量上直接求值的分数函数之间的差异。这一联系不仅量化了偏移，也解释了为什么在部分测量上适配分数函数能够改善泛化。在实验中，我们展示这种适配降低了估计的 KL 散度，并在多个逆问题上提升了重建质量。

English original
Domain adaptation methods aim to mitigate distribution shifts between training and test data [32] and are well-studied in the broader machine learning literature [33, 34]. In inverse problems, however, adaptation is particularly challenging due to the unavailability of clean test-time data. Recent self-supervised approaches have explored adapting deep learning models using only measurement-domain signals [35, 36, 37], but these methods are largely heuristic and lack a theoretical justification for their effectiveness. Our metric provides a principled framework that formally connects distribution shifts to the discrepancy between score functions, evaluated directly on corrupted measurements. This connection not only quantifies the shift but also explains why adapting score functions on partial measurements can improve generalization. Empirically, we show that such adaptation reduces the estimated KL divergence and improves reconstruction quality across multiple inverse problems.

我们的贡献是：(1) 首个只依赖受损测量的、测量域的分布偏移闭式估计。我们证明所提出的度量可以等于图像域 KL 散度——无需基准真值图像。(2) 在包括修复与 MRI 的两个逆问题上，仅使用受损测量，实证验证所提出的度量能很好地逼近 KL 散度。(3) 受该度量启发，提出一个简单的适配方法：仅使用受损测量，把 OOD 分数函数与 InD 数据对齐。我们的结果确认，这种对齐降低了估计的分布偏移，并提升了逆问题的重建性能。

English original
Our contributions are: (1) The first closed-form, measurement-domain estimate of distribution shifts that relies only on corrupted measurements. We prove that the proposed metric can equal the image-domain KL divergence—without requiring ground-truth images. (2) Empirical validation that the proposed metric closely approximates the KL divergence across two inverse problems, including inpainting and MRI, using only corrupted measurements. (3) Motivated by the proposed metric, a simple adaptation approach that aligns the OOD score function with the InD data using only corrupted measurements. Our results confirm that this alignment reduces the estimated distribution shift and improves reconstruction performance in inverse problems.

2 背景

English original
2 Background

2.1 去噪扩散概率模型

English original
2.1 Denoising Diffusion Probabilistic Models

扩散模型 [10, 11, 15] 被训练来估计数据分布的分数函数——也就是对数密度的梯度。训练时，一个前向过程在多个步骤中逐步向干净数据样本 x∼p(x)\boldsymbol{x}\sim p(\boldsymbol{x})x∼p(x) 加入高斯噪声，而模型学习通过在每个步骤对受损样本去噪来反转这个过程。这个前向过程通常被建模为马尔可夫链 xσ0→xσ1→⋯→xσ∞\boldsymbol{x}_{\sigma_{0}}\rightarrow\boldsymbol{x}_{\sigma_{1}}\rightarrow\cdots\rightarrow\boldsymbol{x}_{\sigma_{\infty}}xσ0​​→xσ1​​→⋯→xσ∞​​，其中 xσ0=x\boldsymbol{x}_{\sigma_{0}}=\boldsymbol{x}xσ0​​=x 是干净图像，噪声层级 σ0<σ1<⋯<σ∞\sigma_{0}<\sigma_{1}<\cdots<\sigma_{\infty}σ0​<σ1​<⋯<σ∞​ 在每一步增大。我们用 σ≔[σ0,⋯ ,σ∞]\boldsymbol{\sigma}\coloneqq[\sigma_{0},\cdots,\sigma_{\infty}]σ:=[σ0​,⋯,σ∞​] 表示全部噪声层级的集合，它对应一个随时间的扩散过程。

English original
Diffusion models [10, 11, 15] are trained to estimate the score function of the data distribution—that is the gradient of the log-density. During training, a forward process progressively adds Gaussian noise to clean data samples x ∼ p(x) over multiple steps, while the model learns to reverse this process by denoising the corrupted samples at each step. This forward process is typically modeled as a Markov chain, x_σ0 → x_σ1 → ⋯ → x_σ∞, where x_σ0 = x is the clean image and noise levels σ0 < σ1 < ⋯ < σ∞ increase at each step. We denote the full set of noise levels by σ := [σ0, ⋯, σ∞], which corresponds to a time-dependent diffusion process.

中间含噪变量 xσ\boldsymbol{x}_{\sigma}xσ​ 用一个高斯核定义：

高斯核（原文未编号）
p(xσ∣x)=N(x,σ2I)p(\boldsymbol{x}_{\sigma}\mid\boldsymbol{x}) = \mathcal{N}(\boldsymbol{x},\sigma^{2}\boldsymbol{I})p(xσ​∣x)=N(x,σ2I)

这使得可以直接采样 xσ=x+n\boldsymbol{x}_{\sigma}=\boldsymbol{x}+\boldsymbol{n}xσ​=x+n，其中 n∼N(0,σ2I)\boldsymbol{n}\sim\mathcal{N}(0,\sigma^{2}\boldsymbol{I})n∼N(0,σ2I)。噪声图像的边缘分布记为 pσ(xσ)p_{\sigma}(\boldsymbol{x}_{\sigma})pσ​(xσ​)，由下式给出：

公式 (1)
pσ(xσ)=∫p(xσ∣x) p(x) dx=∫Gσ(xσ−x) p(x) dxp_{\sigma}(\boldsymbol{x}_{\sigma}) = \int p(\boldsymbol{x}_{\sigma}\mid\boldsymbol{x})\,p(\boldsymbol{x})\,\mathrm{d}\boldsymbol{x} = \int G_{\sigma}(\boldsymbol{x}_{\sigma}-\boldsymbol{x})\,p(\boldsymbol{x})\,\mathrm{d}\boldsymbol{x}pσ​(xσ​)=∫p(xσ​∣x)p(x)dx=∫Gσ​(xσ​−x)p(x)dx

其中 GσG_{\sigma}Gσ​ 表示标准差为 σ≥0\sigma\ge 0σ≥0 的高斯密度函数。

English original
The intermediate noisy variable x_σ is defined using a Gaussian kernel: p(x_σ | x) = N(x, σ²I), which enables direct sampling via x_σ = x + n, where n ∼ N(0, σ²I). The marginal distribution of the noisy images, denoted p_σ(x_σ), is given by Eq. (1), where G_σ denotes the Gaussian density function with standard deviation σ ≥ 0.

Tweedie 公式通过在噪声破坏后密度的分数中表达后验均值，在高斯去噪与分数估计之间建立了联系 [38, 39]：

公式 (2)
Dσ(xσ)=E[x∣xσ]=xσ+σ2∇log⁡pσ(xσ)\mathsf{D}_{\sigma}(\boldsymbol{x}_{\sigma}) = \mathbb{E}[\boldsymbol{x}\mid\boldsymbol{x}_{\sigma}] = \boldsymbol{x}_{\sigma} + \sigma^{2}\nabla\log p_{\sigma}(\boldsymbol{x}_{\sigma})Dσ​(xσ​)=E[x∣xσ​]=xσ​+σ2∇logpσ​(xσ​)

这一结果意味着，对所有噪声层级 σ≥0\sigma\ge 0σ≥0，学习高斯去噪器 Dσ\mathsf{D}_{\sigma}Dσ​ 等价于学习噪声分布的分数 ∇log⁡pσ(xσ)\nabla\log p_{\sigma}(\boldsymbol{x}_{\sigma})∇logpσ​(xσ​)。在实践中，去噪器 Dσ\mathsf{D}_{\sigma}Dσ​ 被训练来最小化干净信号与去噪信号之间的均方误差（MSE）：

公式 (3)
MSE(Dσ)=Ex,xσ[∥x−Dσ(xσ)∥22]\mathrm{MSE}(\mathsf{D}_{\sigma}) = \mathbb{E}_{\boldsymbol{x},\boldsymbol{x}_{\sigma}}\left[\|\boldsymbol{x}-\mathsf{D}_{\sigma}(\boldsymbol{x}_{\sigma})\|_{2}^{2}\right]MSE(Dσ​)=Ex,xσ​​[∥x−Dσ​(xσ​)∥22​]
English original
Tweedie’s formula establishes a link between Gaussian denoising and score estimation [38, 39] by expressing the posterior mean in terms of the score of the noise-corrupted density, Eq. (2). This result implies that learning the Gaussian denoiser D_σ is equivalent to learning the score ∇ log p_σ(x_σ) of the noisy distribution, for all noise levels σ ≥ 0. In practice, the denoiser D_σ is trained to minimize the mean squared error (MSE) between the clean and denoised signals, Eq. (3).

一个扩散模型由覆盖所有噪声层级的一组 MMSE 去噪器 {Dσ:σ∈σ}\{\mathsf{D}_{\sigma}:\sigma\in\boldsymbol{\sigma}\}{Dσ​:σ∈σ} 构成，这组去噪器隐式地提供了噪声破坏密度的分数函数 ∇log⁡pσ(xσ)\nabla\log p_{\sigma}(\boldsymbol{x}_{\sigma})∇logpσ​(xσ​)。这些学到的分数函数使得可以通过逆扩散过程从底层干净图像分布 p(x)p(\boldsymbol{x})p(x) 中采样 [40, 41]。

English original
A diffusion model consists of a collection of MMSE denoisers across all noise levels, {D_σ : σ ∈ σ}, which implicitly provide access to the score functions ∇ log p_σ(x_σ) of the noise-corrupted densities. These learned score functions enable sampling from the underlying clean image distribution p(x) via the reverse diffusion process [40, 41].

2.2 用干净图像与分数函数度量分布偏移

English original
2.2 Measuring Distribution Shifts with Clean Images using Score Functions

我们扩展 [42, 43] 中引入的框架，推导 InD 密度 p(x)p(\boldsymbol{x})p(x) 与 OOD 密度 q(x)q(\boldsymbol{x})q(x) 之间 KL 散度的表达式。具体来说，KL 散度可以写成相应噪声破坏分布的分数函数的形式：

公式 (4)
DKL(p(x) ∥ q(x))=∫0∞Ex∼p(x)[∥∇xσlog⁡pσ(xσ)−∇xσlog⁡qσ(xσ)∥22]σ dσD_{\mathrm{KL}}\left(p(\boldsymbol{x})\,\|\,q(\boldsymbol{x})\right) = \int_{0}^{\infty}\mathbb{E}_{\boldsymbol{x}\sim p(\boldsymbol{x})}\left[\|\nabla_{\boldsymbol{x}_{\sigma}}\log p_{\sigma}(\boldsymbol{x}_{\sigma})-\nabla_{\boldsymbol{x}_{\sigma}}\log q_{\sigma}(\boldsymbol{x}_{\sigma})\|_{2}^{2}\right]\sigma\,\mathrm{d}\sigmaDKL​(p(x)∥q(x))=∫0∞​Ex∼p(x)​[∥∇xσ​​logpσ​(xσ​)−∇xσ​​logqσ​(xσ​)∥22​]σdσ

这里 pσ(xσ)p_{\sigma}(\boldsymbol{x}_{\sigma})pσ​(xσ​) 与 qσ(xσ)q_{\sigma}(\boldsymbol{x}_{\sigma})qσ​(xσ​) 分别表示 p(x)p(\boldsymbol{x})p(x) 与 q(x)q(\boldsymbol{x})q(x) 在噪声层级 σ\sigmaσ 下的噪声破坏分布。分数函数 ∇xσlog⁡pσ(xσ)\nabla_{\boldsymbol{x}_{\sigma}}\log p_{\sigma}(\boldsymbol{x}_{\sigma})∇xσ​​logpσ​(xσ​) 可以用 Tweedie 公式估计，该公式按公式 (2) 把它与后验均值 E[x∣xσ]\mathbb{E}[\boldsymbol{x}\mid\boldsymbol{x}_{\sigma}]E[x∣xσ​] 联系起来。这个后验均值又可以借助公式 (3) 的损失训练 MMSE 去噪器来逼近。

English original
We extend the framework introduced in [42, 43] to derive an expression for the KL divergence between the InD p(x) and OOD q(x) densities. In particular, the KL divergence can be expressed in terms of the score functions of the corresponding noise-corrupted distributions as Eq. (4). Here, p_σ(x_σ) and q_σ(x_σ) denote the noise-corrupted distributions of p(x) and q(x), respectively, at noise level σ. The score function ∇ log p_σ(x_σ) can be estimated using the Tweedie’s formula, which relates it to the posterior mean E[x | x_σ] according to Eq. (2). This posterior mean, in turn, can be approximated by training MMSE denoisers via the loss in Eq. (3).

在实践中，扩散模型被训练为跨一系列噪声层级的去噪器，以逼近相应噪声破坏数据分布的分数函数。因此，当有两个扩散模型可用时——一个在来自 p(x)p(\boldsymbol{x})p(x) 的 InD 样本上训练，另一个在来自 q(x)q(\boldsymbol{x})q(x) 的 OOD 样本上训练——就可以估计公式 (4) 中的 KL 散度。

English original
In practice, diffusion models are trained as denoisers across a range of noise levels to approximate the score functions of the corresponding noise-corrupted data distributions. Thus, the KL divergence in Eq. (4) can be estimated when two diffusion models are available: one trained on InD samples from p(x), and another on ODD samples from q(x).

当用扩散模型估计 KL 散度时，假设 InD 与 OOD 两个模型都已准确学到各自数据分布的分数函数。它们在每个噪声层级上学到的去噪器之间的差异，反映了分布偏移的程度。利用深度 MMSE 去噪器提供的条件均值估计与公式 (2) 中分数函数之间的联系，我们得到一个可计算的、度量图像域分布偏移的量（证明见附录 A，另见 [42, 43] 的讨论）。值得注意的是，该度量对应于 InD 与 OOD 扩散模型在所有噪声层级上的积分去噪差距。

English original
When using diffusion models to estimate KL divergence, it is assumed that both the InD and OOD models have accurately learned the score functions of their respective data distributions. The discrepancy between their learned Gaussian denoisers at each noise level reflects the extent of the distribution shift. Leveraging the connection between the conditional mean estimator provided by the deep MMSE denoiser and the score function from Eq. (2), we obtain a tractable metric for measuring distribution shift in image domain (see Appendix A for the proof, as well as [42, 43] for additional discussion). Notably, the resulting metric corresponds to the integrated denoising gap between the InD and OOD diffusion models across all noise levels.

公式 (4) 中的 KL 散度表述，只有在干净 InD 图像可用时，才能量化 InD 密度 p(x)p(\boldsymbol{x})p(x) 与 OOD 密度 q(x)q(\boldsymbol{x})q(x) 之间的偏移。为了覆盖只拥有受损测量这一更现实的设定，我们引入一个无监督度量，直接由这些测量估计同一个分布偏移。

English original
The KL divergence formulation in Eq. (4) quantifies the shift between the InD density p(x) and the OOD density q(x) only when clean InD images are available. To cover the more realistic setting in which we possess only corrupted measurements, we introduce an unsupervised metric that estimates the same distribution shift directly from those measurements.

3 测量域中的分布偏移

English original
3 Distribution Shift in Measurement Domain

公式 (4) 中 KL 散度所需的干净图像，在许多逆问题里是拿不到的。因此我们推导一个测量域的 KL 估计量，直接用观测到的测量与预训练扩散模型来量化分布偏移。

English original
Clean images required for the KL divergence in Eq. (4) are unavailable in many inverse problems. We therefore derive a measurement-domain KL estimator that quantifies distribution shift directly from the observed measurements and pretrained diffusion models.

3.1 问题设定

English original
3.1 Problem Formulation

我们考虑一组从分布 p(H)p(\mathbf{H})p(H) 中随机抽取的测量算子。给定 H∈Rm×n\mathbf{H}\in\mathbb{R}^{m\times n}H∈Rm×n，测量向量 y∈Rm\boldsymbol{y}\in\mathbb{R}^{m}y∈Rm 与底层信号 x∈Rn\boldsymbol{x}\in\mathbb{R}^{n}x∈Rn 通过下式相关联：

公式 (5)
y=Hx+z\boldsymbol{y} = \mathbf{H}\boldsymbol{x} + \boldsymbol{z}y=Hx+z

其中 z∼N(0,σz2I)\boldsymbol{z}\sim\mathcal{N}(0,\sigma_{\boldsymbol{z}}^{2}\boldsymbol{I})z∼N(0,σz2​I) 表示测量噪声。我们假设对问题的每个实例，x\boldsymbol{x}x、z\boldsymbol{z}z 与 H\mathbf{H}H 都独立地从各自的分布中抽取。

English original
We consider a set of measurement operators randomly drawn from the distribution p(H). For a given H ∈ Rm×n, the measurement vector y ∈ Rm is related to the underlying signal x ∈ Rn via Eq. (5), where z ∼ N(0, σ_z² I) denotes the measurement noise. We assume that x, z, and H are independently drawn from their respective distributions for each instance of the problem.

为简化分析，我们对测量算子 H\mathbf{H}H 做奇异值分解（SVD）[44, 45]。这一分解带来一个变换，把测量过程解耦，并使原本定义在图像域的 KL 散度可以改写为测量域的形式。我们把 H\mathbf{H}H 的 SVD 写成

公式 (6)
H=UΣVT\mathbf{H} = \boldsymbol{U}\boldsymbol{\Sigma}\boldsymbol{V}^{\mathsf{T}}H=UΣVT

其中 U∈Rm×m\boldsymbol{U}\in\mathbb{R}^{m\times m}U∈Rm×m 与 V∈Rn×n\boldsymbol{V}\in\mathbb{R}^{n\times n}V∈Rn×n 是正交矩阵，Σ∈Rm×n\boldsymbol{\Sigma}\in\mathbb{R}^{m\times n}Σ∈Rm×n 是奇异值矩阵。我们定义三个变换后的变量：x‾=VTx\overline{\boldsymbol{x}}=\boldsymbol{V}^{\mathsf{T}}\boldsymbol{x}x=VTx、y‾=Σ†UTy\overline{\boldsymbol{y}}=\boldsymbol{\Sigma}^{\dagger}\boldsymbol{U}^{\mathsf{T}}\boldsymbol{y}y​=Σ†UTy 与 z‾=Σ†UTz\overline{\boldsymbol{z}}=\boldsymbol{\Sigma}^{\dagger}\boldsymbol{U}^{\mathsf{T}}\boldsymbol{z}z=Σ†UTz。把这些变量代入公式 (5) 的原始测量模型，得到关系

公式 (7)
y‾=Px‾+z‾\overline{\boldsymbol{y}} = \boldsymbol{P}\overline{\boldsymbol{x}} + \overline{\boldsymbol{z}}y​=Px+z

其中 P=Σ†Σ\boldsymbol{P}=\boldsymbol{\Sigma}^{\dagger}\boldsymbol{\Sigma}P=Σ†Σ 是一个取值在 {0,1}\{0,1\}{0,1} 中的对角投影矩阵，而 z‾∼N(0,σz2Σ†Σ†T)\overline{\boldsymbol{z}}\sim\mathcal{N}(0,\sigma_{\boldsymbol{z}}^{2}\boldsymbol{\Sigma}^{\dagger}{\boldsymbol{\Sigma}^{\dagger}}^{\mathsf{T}})z∼N(0,σz2​Σ†Σ†T) 表示各向异性的、不相关的高斯噪声。

English original
To simplify our analysis, we consider the singular value decomposition (SVD) to the measurement operator H [44, 45]. This decomposition facilitates a transformation that decouples the measurement process and allows the KL divergence—originally defined in the image domain—to be re-expressed in the measurement domain. We write the SVD of H as Eq. (6), where U ∈ Rm×m and V ∈ Rn×n are orthogonal matrices, and Σ ∈ Rm×n is a matrix of singular values. We define three transformed variables: x̄ = VT x, ȳ = Σ† UT y, and z̄ = Σ† UT z. Substitution of these variables into the original measurement model in Eq. (5), leads to relationship Eq. (7), where P = Σ†Σ is a diagonal projection matrix with entries in {0, 1}, and z̄ ∼ N(0, σ_z² Σ† (Σ†)T) represents anisotropic uncorrelated Gaussian noise.

在无噪声设定下，我们可以把公式 (7) 改写为 y‾=Px‾\overline{\boldsymbol{y}}=\boldsymbol{P}\overline{\boldsymbol{x}}y​=Px。对噪声调度向量 σ\boldsymbol{\sigma}σ 中的每个噪声层级 σ\sigmaσ，我们考虑 SVD 观测的一个含噪版本

公式 (8)
y‾σ=Px‾σ=Px‾+n‾=y‾+n‾,n‾=Pn∼N(0,σ2P)\overline{\boldsymbol{y}}_{\sigma} = \boldsymbol{P}\overline{\boldsymbol{x}}_{\sigma} = \boldsymbol{P}\overline{\boldsymbol{x}} + \overline{\boldsymbol{n}} = \overline{\boldsymbol{y}} + \overline{\boldsymbol{n}}, \qquad \overline{\boldsymbol{n}} = \boldsymbol{P}\boldsymbol{n} \sim \mathcal{N}(0,\sigma^{2}\boldsymbol{P})y​σ​=Pxσ​=Px+n=y​+n,n=Pn∼N(0,σ2P)

其中 n∼N(0,σ2I)\boldsymbol{n}\sim\mathcal{N}(0,\sigma^{2}\boldsymbol{I})n∼N(0,σ2I)，P\boldsymbol{P}P 是正交投影。注意 z\boldsymbol{z}z 指逆问题中的测量噪声，而 n\boldsymbol{n}n 表示扩散过程中加入的噪声。

English original
In the noiseless setting, we can rewrite Eq. (7) as ȳ = P x̄. For every noise level σ in the noise schedule vector σ, we consider a noisy version of the SVD observations, Eq. (8), where n ∼ N(0, σ²I) and P is an orthogonal projection. Note that z refers to measurement noise in inverse problems, while n denotes noise added in the diffusion process.

3.2 理论结果

English original
3.2 Theoretical Results

现在我们给出度量 InD 先验 p(x)p(\boldsymbol{x})p(x) 与 OOD 先验 q(x)q(\boldsymbol{x})q(x) 之间分布偏移的主要理论结果。下面的定理 1 给出的是无噪声测量的结果，成像系统建模为 y=Hx\boldsymbol{y}=\mathbf{H}\boldsymbol{x}y=Hx。我们在附录 C 的定理 2 中把该结果推广到含噪情形。

English original
We now present our main theoretical result for measuring the distribution shift between the InD prior p(x) and OOD prior q(x). Theorem 1 below presents results for noiseless measurements for imaging systems modeled as y = Hx. We extend this result to the noisy case in Theorem 2 of Appendix C.

为建立理论结果，我们需要如下假设。

English original
We require the following assumptions to establish our theoretical results.

假设 1。在各项实验中使用的测量算子 H∼p(H)\mathbf{H}\sim p(\mathbf{H})H∼p(H) 的值域，合起来张成信号空间 Rn\mathbb{R}^{n}Rn。

English original
Assumption 1. The range of the measurement operators H ∼ p(H), used across experiments collectively spans the signal space Rn.

该假设要求：平均而言，这些测量算子合起来能观测到每一个信号方向——形式上即 E[P]\mathbb{E}[\boldsymbol{P}]E[P] 在相关子空间上满秩。这一假设在自监督逆问题中被普遍采用 [45, 46]。

English original
The assumption enforces that, on average, the measurement operators collectively observe every signal direction—formally E[P] is full-rank on the relevant subspace. This assumption is commonly adopted in self-supervised inverse problems [45, 46].

假设 2。这组测量算子 H\mathbf{H}H 共享同一个右奇异矩阵。每个 H\mathbf{H}H 都具有形式 H=UΣVT\mathbf{H}=\boldsymbol{U}\boldsymbol{\Sigma}\boldsymbol{V}^{\mathsf{T}}H=UΣVT，其中矩阵 V∈Rn×n\boldsymbol{V}\in\mathbb{R}^{n\times n}V∈Rn×n 对所有 H∼p(H)\mathbf{H}\sim p(\mathbf{H})H∼p(H) 固定不变。

English original
Assumption 2. The set of measurement operators H share a common right-singular matrix. Each H has the form H = UΣVT with a fixed matrix V ∈ Rn×n, for all H ∼ p(H).

共享子空间假设保证了所有 H\mathbf{H}H 拥有共同的隐基底，从而允许跨算子直接比较分数函数与去噪输出。这一条件在许多逆问题中自然成立，例如欠采样傅里叶成像与修复 [45, 47, 48]。现在可以给出我们的主要结果。

English original
The shared-subspace assumption guarantees a common latent basis for all H, permitting direct comparison of score functions and denoising outputs across operators. This condition naturally holds in many inverse problems, such as subsampled Fourier imaging and inpainting [45, 47, 48]. We can now present our main result.

定理 1。设 y‾σ=Px‾+n‾\overline{\boldsymbol{y}}_{\sigma}=\boldsymbol{P}\overline{\boldsymbol{x}}+\overline{\boldsymbol{n}}y​σ​=Px+n 表示按公式 (8) 在噪声层级 σ\sigmaσ 下的含噪投影测量。那么，InD 密度 p(x)p(\boldsymbol{x})p(x) 与 OOD 密度 q(x)q(\boldsymbol{x})q(x) 之间的 KL 散度可以写成

公式 (9)
DKL(p(x) ∥ q(x))=∫0∞E[∥W(∇log⁡pσ(Vy‾σ)−∇log⁡qσ(Vy‾σ))∥22] σ dσD_{\mathrm{KL}}\left(p(\boldsymbol{x})\,\|\,q(\boldsymbol{x})\right) = \int_{0}^{\infty}\mathbb{E}\big[\|\boldsymbol{W}(\nabla\log p_{\sigma}(\boldsymbol{V}\overline{\boldsymbol{y}}_{\sigma})-\nabla\log q_{\sigma}(\boldsymbol{V}\overline{\boldsymbol{y}}_{\sigma}))\|_{2}^{2}\big]\,\sigma\,\mathrm{d}\sigmaDKL​(p(x)∥q(x))=∫0∞​E[∥W(∇logpσ​(Vy​σ​)−∇logqσ​(Vy​σ​))∥22​]σdσ

其中 W=E[P]−3/2\boldsymbol{W}=\mathbb{E}[\boldsymbol{P}]^{-3/2}W=E[P]−3/2 是对角缩放矩阵，V\boldsymbol{V}V 是 H\mathbf{H}H 的 SVD 中的右奇异向量，期望对 P\boldsymbol{P}P 与 y‾∼p(y‾∣P)\overline{\boldsymbol{y}}\sim p(\overline{\boldsymbol{y}}\mid\boldsymbol{P})y​∼p(y​∣P) 取。

English original
Theorem 1. Let ȳ_σ = P x̄ + n̄ denote the noisy projected measurements at noise level σ according to Eq. (8). Then, the KL divergence between the InD density p(x) and the OOD density q(x) can be expressed as Eq. (9), where W = E[P]−3/2 is a diagonal scaling matrix, V is the right singular vector from SVD of H, and expectation is taken over P and ȳ ∼ p(ȳ | P).

定理 1 表明，给定无噪声测量 y=Hx\boldsymbol{y}=\mathbf{H}\boldsymbol{x}y=Hx，p(x)p(\boldsymbol{x})p(x) 与 q(x)q(\boldsymbol{x})q(x) 之间的 KL 散度完全可以只用测量域数据计算。此时 KL 散度表示为在 Vy‾σ\boldsymbol{V}\overline{\boldsymbol{y}}_{\sigma}Vy​σ​ 处求值的 InD 与 OOD 分数函数之差的泛函，其中 Vy‾σ\boldsymbol{V}\overline{\boldsymbol{y}}_{\sigma}Vy​σ​ 是把 y\boldsymbol{y}y 投影到 H\mathbf{H}H 的行空间、再用扩散噪声 σ\sigmaσ 扰动得到的。这一结果使我们仅用观测到的测量、已知的前向算子与预训练的分数函数就能量化分布偏移——无需访问底层干净图像。

English original
Theorem 1 shows that, given noiseless measurements y = Hx, the KL divergence between p(x) and q(x) can be computed entirely using the measurement domain data. The KL divergence is then expressed as a functional of the difference between the InD and OOD score functions evaluated at V ȳ_σ, where V ȳ_σ is obtained by projecting y onto the row space of H and perturbing it with diffusion noise σ. This result enables us to quantify the distribution shift using only the observed measurements, the known forward operator, and pre-trained score functions—without requiring access to the underlying clean images.

引入权重矩阵 W\boldsymbol{W}W 是为了补偿投影矩阵 P\boldsymbol{P}P 的影响，确保所有分量按比例贡献——尤其是在不同 P\boldsymbol{P}P 实现出现的可能性不均衡时。分布 p(x)p(\boldsymbol{x})p(x) 与 q(x)q(\boldsymbol{x})q(x) 的分数函数可直接从预训练扩散模型获得。KL 近似的精度直接取决于期望估计的质量，而这又取决于计算中使用的示例测量数 NNN。随着 NNN 增大，期望的经验估计更可靠，对 KL 散度的近似也更紧。图 2 用高斯混合模型（GMM）的玩具例子说明了这一关系：图中把 InD 与 OOD 分布之间的 KL 散度画成扩散噪声层级 σ\sigmaσ 的函数。蓝线表示在图像域计算的 KL 散度，红线表示在概率为 ppp 的修复破坏下测量域中相应的近似。可以看到，测量域 KL 紧密跟踪其图像域对应量，验证了所提出度量在不同程度测量破坏下的有效性。

English original
The weighting matrix W is introduced to compensate for the effect of the projection matrix P, ensuring that all components contribute proportionally—particularly when the likelihood of different P realizations is imbalanced. The score functions for the distributions p(x) and q(x) are directly accessible from the pretrained diffusion models. The accuracy of the KL approximation is directly tied to the quality of the expectation estimate, which depends on the number of example measurements N used in the computation. As N increases, the empirical estimate of the expectation becomes more reliable, leading to a tighter approximation of the KL divergence. Figure 2 illustrates this relationship using a toy example with Gaussian mixture models (GMMs), where the KL divergence between InD and OOD distributions is plotted as a function of the diffusion noise level σ. The blue curve represents the KL divergence computed in the image domain, while the red curve shows the corresponding approximation in the measurement domain under inpainting corruption with probability p. As shown, the measurement-domain KL closely tracks its image-domain counterpart, validating the effectiveness of our proposed metric under varying levels of measurement corruption.

定理 1 的证明见附录 B。含噪测量的推广由定理 2 给出，相应证明见附录 C。值得注意的是，定理 1 并不要求测量算子 H\mathbf{H}H 可逆。但当 H\mathbf{H}H 可逆时，KL 散度的表达式会大幅简化，详见附录 B 中的推论 1。在这个特例中，不需要考虑一族测量算子 H∼p(H)\mathbf{H}\sim p(\mathbf{H})H∼p(H)。

English original
The proof of Theorem 1 is provided in Appendix B. An extension to the case of noisy measurements is presented in Theorem 2, with the corresponding proof in Appendix C. Notably, Theorem 1 does not require the measurement operator H to be invertible. However, when H is invertible, the KL divergence expression simplifies significantly, as detailed in Corollary 1 in Appendix B. In this special case, there is no need to consider a set of measurement operators H ∼ p(H).

4 实验

English original
4 Experiments

本节用实验验证所提出的度量在量化分布偏移上的有效性。我们用图像修复与欠采样 MRI 模拟测量算子，并在无噪声与含噪两种测量模型下，按定理 1 与定理 2 计算 KL 散度。

English original
In this section, we empirically validate the effectiveness of the proposed metric in quantifying distribution shifts. We simulate measurement operators through image inpainting and subsampled MRI, and compute the KL divergence as defined in Theorems 1 and 2, under both noiseless and noisy measurement models.

利用 KL 散度与分数函数之间的理论联系，我们对 OOD 扩散模型施加一个适配过程：仅使用受损测量更新其分数函数，以降低分布偏移。随后我们评估这种适配对性能的影响。最后，我们分析 KL 散度的变化与逆问题重建性能如何相关，说明降低分布偏移会为基于扩散模型的推理带来更好的先验。

English original
Leveraging the theoretical connection between the KL divergence and the score functions, we apply an adaptation procedure to the OOD diffusion models by updating their score functions using only corrupted measurements to reduce the distribution shift. We then evaluate the impact of this adaptation on performance. Finally, we analyze how changes in the KL divergence correlate with reconstruction performance in inverse problems, showing that reducing the distribution shift leads to a better prior for diffusion model-based inference.

4.1 计算分布偏移

English original
4.1 Computing Distribution Shift

修复（inpainting）。为评估所提出的 KL 度量在修复破坏下量化分布偏移的效果，我们用 Flickr-Faces-HQ（FFHQ）数据集 [49] 作为 InD 数据。对应密度 p(x)p(\boldsymbol{x})p(x) 的分数函数来自在 FFHQ 上训练的扩散模型。

English original
Inpainting. To evaluate the proposed KL metric for quantifying distribution shift under inpainting corruption, we use the Flickr-Faces-HQ (FFHQ) dataset [49] as the InD data. The score function corresponding to the density p(x) is obtained from the diffusion model trained on FFHQ.

对于 OOD 密度 q(x)q(\boldsymbol{x})q(x)，我们分别在 Animal Faces-HQ（AFHQ）[50]、MetFaces [51] 与 Microscopy（CHAMMI）[52] 数据集上训练了独立的扩散模型。我们沿用 [45] 的设定来模拟修复破坏：把图像缩放到 64×6464\times 6464×64，划分为互不重叠的 4×44\times 44×4 小块，每一块以概率 ppp 被随机擦除。所有扩散模型都用 [15] 的框架训练。

English original
For the OOD densities q(x), we train separate diffusion models on the Animal Faces-HQ (AFHQ) [50], MetFaces [51], and Microscopy (CHAMMI) [52] datasets. We follow the setup in [45] to simulate inpainting corruptions: images resized to 64 × 64 are divided into non-overlapping 4 × 4 patches, each of which is randomly erased with probability p. All diffusion models are trained using the framework in [15].

我们用定理 1 所提出的度量计算 KL 散度，它直接由受损测量估计分布偏移。与之对比的是用公式 (4) 在图像域计算的 KL 散度。假设扩散模型准确刻画了真实分数函数，则图像域 KL 散度可以作为衡量分布偏移的基准真值。

English original
We compute the KL divergence using the proposed metric in Theorem 1, which estimates the distribution shift directly from the corrupted measurements. This is compared to the KL divergence computed in the image domain using Eq. (4). Assuming the diffusion models accurately capture the true score functions, the image-domain KL divergence serves as a ground truth for measuring the distribution shift.

磁共振成像（MRI）。MRI 是一种广泛使用的医学成像技术，它借助磁场梯度在频域（k 空间）采集数据。为缩短扫描时间、减轻病人不适，k 空间常被欠采样，由此获得加速采集，但会产生不适定的逆问题 [53, 54]。

English original
Magnetic resonance imaging (MRI). MRI is a widely used medical imaging technique that acquires data in the frequency domain (k-space) using magnetic field gradients. To reduce scan time and patient discomfort, k-space is often under-sampled, resulting in accelerated acquisitions but yielding ill-posed inverse problems [53, 54].

我们在 MRI 欠采样下评估所提出的 KL 散度度量。来自 fastMRI 数据集 [55, 56] 的脑部 MRI 扫描作为 InD，用在这些中心裁剪到 320×320320\times 320320×320 的切片上训练的扩散模型来表示 p(x)p(\boldsymbol{x})p(x) 的分数函数。来自 fastMRI 的膝关节与前列腺 MRI 切片用于训练 OOD 扩散模型。为模拟加速 MRI 欠采样，我们沿用 [45, 54] 的协议，施加加速因子 R∈{4,6,8}R\in\{4,6,8\}R∈{4,6,8} 的笛卡尔欠采样掩膜，其中高频分量被随机采样。

English original
We evaluate the proposed KL divergence metric under MRI subsampling. Brain MRI scans from the fastMRI dataset [55, 56] serve as the InD, with a diffusion model trained on center-cropped 320 × 320 slices to represent the score function of p(x). Knee and prostate MRI slices from fastMRI are used for training the OOD diffusion models. To simulate accelerated MRI subsampling, we follow the protocol in [45, 54], applying Cartesian under-sampling masks with acceleration factors R ∈ {4, 6, 8}, where high-frequency components are sampled randomly.

图 3 比较了在测量域与图像域计算的 KL 散度值。红色曲线表示脑部（InD）与前列腺（OOD）MRI 之间的分布偏移，绿色曲线表示脑部与膝部 MRI 之间的偏移。虚线对应图像域 KL 值，实线对应直接由受损测量算出的值。值得注意的是，脑部 MRI 与每个 OOD 数据集之间的分布差距，在用干净图像与用 MRI 测量计算出的 KL 散度中保持一致，这说明所提出的 KL 度量能够仅凭受损测量可靠地量化分布偏移。更多实验结果见附录 E。

English original
Figure 3 compares KL divergence values computed in the measurement- and the image-domain. Red plots represent the distribution shift between brain (InD) and prostate (OOD) MRIs, while green plots indicate the shift between brain and knee MRIs. Dashed lines correspond to image-domain KL values, and solid lines to those computed directly from corrupted measurements. Notably, the distribution gap between brain MRI and each OOD dataset remains consistent across the KL divergence computed from clean images and MRI measurements, suggesting the reliability of the proposed KL metric for quantifying distribution shifts using only corrupted measurements. Additional experimental results are included in Appendix E.

4.2 适配对分布偏移的影响

English original
4.2 Adaptation Effect on Distribution Shift

定理 1 通过把 InD 与 OOD 先验之间的 KL 散度写成二者分数函数在含噪测量上求值的期望平方差，给出了该散度的一种新刻画。这一表述自然启发我们：用投影测量来适配去噪网络。因为降低这些位置上的分数函数差异，会直接减小 KL 散度，从而减小分布偏移。

English original
Theorem 1 introduces a new characterization of the KL divergence between InD and OOD priors by expressing it as the expected squared difference between their score functions evaluated on noisy measurements. This formulation naturally motivates adapting the denoising network using projected measurements, as reducing the score function discrepancy at those locations directly decreases the KL divergence and, consequently, the distribution shift.

为实证验证这一点，我们从一个在 OOD 数据集（AFHQ）上训练的扩散模型出发，用来自 InD 数据集（FFHQ）的投影测量对它做轻量适配。具体地，我们从 InD 分布中选出 646464（或 128128128）张干净训练图像，取得它们的受损测量，并投影到由测量算子定义的隐基底上（即计算 Vy‾\boldsymbol{V}\overline{\boldsymbol{y}}Vy​）。图 4 画出得到的 KL 散度随噪声层级 σ\sigmaσ 的变化，把原始 AFHQ 模型与两个适配版本作对比：Adapted64（用 646464 条投影测量适配）与 Adapted128（用 128128128 条）。适配过程的更多细节见附录 E.4。结果显示，即使只基于受损测量做适度适配，也能显著降低 KL 散度。

English original
To empirically validate this, we begin with a diffusion model trained on the OOD dataset (AFHQ) and apply lightweight adaptation using projected measurements from the InD dataset (FFHQ). Specifically, we select 64 (or 128) clean training images from the InD distribution, obtain their corrupted measurements, and project them onto the latent basis defined by the measurement operator (i.e., compute V ȳ). Figure 4 plots the resulting KL divergence as a function of noise level σ, comparing the original AFHQ model with two adapted variants: Adapted64 (adapted using 64 projected measurements) and Adapted128 (using 128). Further details on the adaptation procedure are provided in Appendix E.4. The results show that even modest adaptation based solely on corrupted measurements significantly reduces the KL divergence.

我们评估分布偏移——以及用适配来应对它——对成像逆问题的影响。我们聚焦于用 DPS [17] 求解图像修复，使用四个模型：InD 模型（FFHQ）、OOD 模型（AFHQ），以及用来自 FFHQ 的 646464 与 128128128 条投影测量适配过的 AFHQ 模型。适配过程微调 OOD 模型，使其在来自 InD 的受损投影测量上更好地逼近分数函数，且不使用干净图像。

English original
We evaluate the impact of distribution shift—and adaptation on addressing it—on imaging inverse problems. We focus on solving image inpainting using DPS [17] with four models: an InD model (FFHQ), an OOD model (AFHQ), and the AFHQ model adapted using 64 and 128 projected measurements from FFHQ. The adaptation procedure fine-tunes the OOD model to better approximate the score function on corrupted projected measurements from the InD, without using clean images.

图 5 给出了在概率 p=0.8p=0.8p=0.8 的修复掩膜、测量噪声层级 σz=0.01\sigma_{\boldsymbol{z}}=0.01σz​=0.01 下，对一张 FFHQ 测试图像做修复的视觉对比，并报告 PSNR 与 LPIPS。如预期，OOD 模型在 InD 数据上表现很差，而用投影测量做适配改善了视觉质量。表 1 定量比较了不同模型与测量设定下 DPS 的重建质量。值得注意的是，适配后的模型相对未适配的 OOD 模型有明显提升，确认即使只做基于部分测量的适配也有助于缩小分布偏移。

English original
Figure 5 presents a visual comparison of inpainting results on a test image from FFHQ under an inpainting mask with sampling probability p = 0.8 and measurement noise level σ_z = 0.01. PSNR and LPIPS metrics are reported. As expected, the OOD model performs poorly on the InD data, while adaptation using projected measurements improves visual quality. Table 1 quantitatively compares DPS reconstruction quality across models and measurement settings. Notably, the adapted models show clear gains over the unadapted OOD model, confirming that even partial measurement-based adaptation helps shrink the distribution shift.

4.3 消融研究

English original
4.3 Ablation studies

我们研究改变修复测量概率（它控制不适定程度）如何影响所提出度量对 KL 散度近似的准确度。图 6 展示了在干净图像上计算的 KL 散度，与用不同修复概率掩膜后的测量得到的度量之间的差异。如预期，测量破坏越轻（即采样概率越高），KL 散度估计越准。不过，即使在高度测量破坏下，所提出的度量仍能有效给出图像域 KL 散度的近似。

English original
We study how varying the inpainting measurement probability, which controls the degree of ill-posedness, influences the accuracy of KL divergence approximation using the proposed metric. Figure 6 illustrates the difference between the KL divergence computed on clean images and our metric obtained from measurements masked with varying inpainting probabilities. As expected, lower measurement corruption (i.e., higher sampling probability) leads to more accurate KL divergence estimates. However, the proposed metric remains effective in providing an approximation of the image-domain KL divergence, even under high levels of measurement corruption.

表 2 给出一个消融研究，分析 KL 散度近似如何随测量噪声 σz\sigma_{\boldsymbol{z}}σz​ 与来自 InD 数据集的测量示例数 NNN 变化。结果显示即使在大噪声下 KL 估计仍然稳定，这既支持所提出度量的稳健性，也验证了定理 2。值得注意的是，仅用 20 个样本即可获得可靠估计，说明该度量在含噪与无噪声设定下、仅用有限的 InD 测量示例就有效。

English original
Table 2 presents an ablation study analyzing how the KL divergence approximation responds to measurement noise σ_z and number of measurement examples N from InD dataset. The results show that KL estimates remain stable even under substantial noise, supporting the robustness of the proposed metric and validating Theorem 2. Notably, reliable estimates are obtained with as few as 20 samples, demonstrating the metric’s effectiveness in both noisy and noiseless setting, using limited number of measurement examples from InD dataset.

5 结论

English original
5 Conclusion

本工作提出了一种有原理的方法，仅使用受损测量即可无监督地检测与量化成像逆问题中的分布偏移。借助基于分数的扩散模型，我们引入一个测量域的 KL 散度估计量，它无需访问干净的测试图像就能准确反映底层的分布差异——而缺少干净测试图像正是许多真实逆问题中的主要限制。我们的理论结果在修复与 MRI 任务上得到实证验证，表明所提出的度量与图像域 KL 散度吻合良好，并可用于指导适配策略。通过一种简单而有效的基于测量的适配，我们展示对齐分数函数可以降低估计的 KL 散度并带来更好的重建质量。这项工作不仅为分布偏移的稳健评估奠定了基础，也为缓解其影响提供了一个实用方向。

English original
This work presents a principled approach to unsupervised detection and quantification of distribution shift in imaging inverse problems using only corrupted measurements. By leveraging score-based diffusion models, we introduce a measurement-domain KL divergence estimator that accurately reflects the underlying distributional discrepancy without requiring access to clean test images—a major limitation in many real-world inverse problems. Our theoretical results, validated empirically on inpainting and MRI tasks, demonstrate that the proposed metric aligns well with image-domain KL divergence and can guide adaptation strategies. Through a simple yet effective measurement-based adaptation, we show that aligning score functions reduces the estimated KL divergence and leads to improved reconstruction quality. This work not only establishes a foundation for robust evaluation of distribution shift but also offers a practical direction for mitigating its impact.

局限性与影响声明

English original
Limitations & Impact Statement

局限性。尽管有其贡献，我们的方法仍有若干局限。该方法依赖扩散模型来估计数据分数函数，这会引入固有的近似误差，可能影响估计的 KL 散度的准确度。不过，这一假设在近期利用扩散模型做基于分数推理的工作中是标准的 [43, 57, 58]，而且这类近似在实践中已被证明有效。此外，我们的理论结果依赖 3.2 节列出的假设，这些假设对所考虑的测量模型（MRI 与修复）成立，但未必能推广到所有实际设定——尤其是那些缺少共享右奇异向量或投影矩阵不满秩的情形。

English original
Limitations. Despite its contributions, our approach has several limitations. The approach relies on diffusion models to estimate the data score function, which introduces inherent approximation errors that may affect the accuracy of the estimated KL divergence. However, this assumption is standard in recent works that leverage diffusion models for score-based inference [43, 57, 58], and such approximations have been shown to be effective in practice. Moreover, our theoretical results rely on assumptions outlined in Section 3.2, which hold for the considered measurement models (MRI and inpainting) but may not generalize to all practical settings—particularly those lacking shared right-singular vectors or full-rank projection matrices.

影响声明。本文提出一种可靠的无监督方法，用扩散模型量化逆问题中的分布偏移，且不需要访问干净的测试数据。这一能力在医疗 MRI 等高风险成像应用中尤其有价值，因为获取基准真值往往不切实际甚至不可能。我们的方法使从业者能够评估预训练扩散模型的稳健性、识别分布失配，并施加轻量适配来提升性能。虽然主要聚焦于图像修复与 MRI，该方法学可推广到其他测量模型。

English original
Impact Statement. This paper introduces a reliable unsupervised method for quantifying distribution shifts in inverse problems using diffusion models—without requiring access to clean test data. This capability is especially valuable in high-stakes imaging applications, such as medical MRI, where acquiring ground truth is often impractical or impossible. Our approach enables practitioners to assess the robustness of pre-trained diffusion models, identify distribution mismatches, and apply lightweight adaptations to improve performance. While primarily focused on image inpainting and MRI, the methodology could be generalized to other measurement models.

附录 D　相关工作

English original
Appendix D: Related Works

训练分布与测试分布之间的分布偏移是机器学习中的根本挑战，直接影响模型的可靠性与稳健性 [59, 60, 1, 61]。准确度量分布偏移对于理解模型何时泛化不佳至关重要，而 OOD 检测技术往往通过评估基于特征、基于似然或基于重建的 OOD 指标来提示这类偏移 [62, 63, 64]。然而，许多现有方法依赖对干净样本的完整访问，这限制了它们在受损或测量受限设定下的适用性 [28, 65, 66, 67, 30, 68]。

English original
Distribution shift between training and test data distributions is a fundamental challenge in machine learning, with direct implications for model reliability and robustness [59, 60, 1, 61]. Accurately measuring distribution shift is essential for understanding when models will generalize poorly, and OOD detection techniques often aim to signal such shifts by evaluating feature-based, likelihood-based, or reconstruction-based OOD metrics [62, 63, 64]. However, many existing methods rely on full access to clean samples, limiting their applicability in corrupted or measurement-limited settings [28, 65, 66, 67, 30, 68].

为缓解分布偏移的影响，人们发展了适配策略：在训练之后修改模型，使其更好地与测试分布对齐 [32]。在扩散模型的语境下，这类策略通常着眼于调整生成过程、修改分数函数，或通过微调提升对域偏移的稳健性 [69, 70, 71, 72, 73]。这些方法虽然能减轻性能退化，但往往假设可以访问干净的适配样本或重建代理。

English original
To mitigate the impact of distribution shift, adaptation strategies have been developed that modify models post-training to better align with the test distribution [32]. In the context of diffusion models, such strategies typically focus on adjusting the generative process, modifying score functions, or fine-tuning to improve robustness against domain shifts [69, 70, 71, 72, 73]. While these methods can reduce performance degradation, they often assume access to clean adaptation samples or reconstruction proxies.

在成像逆问题中，分布偏移、OOD 检测与适配的挑战因测试时没有干净图像而被放大 [74, 75, 76, 35, 19]。量化偏移与适配模型的常规方法不能直接套用，因为只有受损测量可用。这就产生了对测量域度量与适配技术的需求——它们需要在不需要基准真值重建的情况下工作，而这正是本文所处理的设定。

English original
In imaging inverse problems, the challenges of distribution shift, OOD detection, and adaptation are amplified by the absence of clean images at test time [74, 75, 76, 35, 19]. Conventional approaches to quantifying shift and adapting models are not directly applicable, as only corrupted measurements are available. This motivates the need for measurement-domain metrics and adaptation techniques that operate without requiring ground-truth reconstructions—precisely the setting we address in this work.

Similar training strategy was used for microscopy and MetFaces diffusion models on NVIDIA A100 GPUs. All experiments regarding KL divergence were obtained using one NVIDIA RTX A6000 GPU.

测量模型。我们沿用 [45] 的修复破坏设定：退化算子 H\mathbf{H}H 以概率 ppp、逐样本独立地随机屏蔽每张图像上互不重叠的 4×44\times 44×4 小块。每个 H\mathbf{H}H 都是随样本而变的二叉对角矩阵，逐元素作用。作为对角矩阵，H\mathbf{H}H 对称、幂等，并具有奇异值分解 H=IΣI⊤\mathbf{H}=\boldsymbol{I}\boldsymbol{\Sigma}\boldsymbol{I}^{\top}H=IΣI⊤，其中 Σ=H\boldsymbol{\Sigma}=\mathbf{H}Σ=H 的元素取值为 {0,1}\{0,1\}{0,1}。这意味着投影矩阵 P=H⊤H=H\boldsymbol{P}=\mathbf{H}^{\top}\mathbf{H}=\mathbf{H}P=H⊤H=H，并且所有测量算子共享相同的右奇异向量 V=I\boldsymbol{V}=\boldsymbol{I}V=I，从而满足假设 2。此外，屏蔽的随机性保证所有像素最终都会在不同的 H\mathbf{H}H 下被观测到，其行空间之并张成 Rn\mathbb{R}^{n}Rn，从而满足假设 1。

English original
Measurement model. We followed the inpainting corruption setup from [45], where the degradation operator H randomly masks non-overlapping 4 × 4 patches across each image with probability p, independently per sample. Each H is a sample-specific binary diagonal matrix that acts element-wise. As a diagonal matrix, H is symmetric, idempotent, and admits the singular value decomposition H = IΣIT, where Σ = H has entries in {0,1}. This implies that the projection matrix P = HT H = H, and all measurement operators share the same right-singular vectors V = I, satisfying Assumption 2. Moreover, the stochastic nature of the masking ensures that all pixels are eventually observed across different H, and the union of their row spaces spans Rn, satisfying Assumption 1.

E.2 FastMRI

English original
E.2 FastMRI

数据集。我们用 fastMRI 数据集 [55, 56] 中的脑部 MRI 图像作为 InD 数据。所有图像在训练时都中心裁剪到 320×320320\times 320320×320 的分辨率。训练集由 48,406 个切片组成，只包含索引大于 5 的切片。OOD 数据方面，我们从单线圈膝部 MRI 扫描中提取 29,877 个切片，从前列腺 MRI 扫描中提取 7,673 个切片。评估时，用脑部 MRI 验证集中的 20 张图像作为测试集。

English original
Datasets. We use brain MRI images from the fastMRI dataset [55, 56] as the InD data. All images are center-cropped to a resolution of 320 × 320 for training. The training set consists of 48,406 slices, where only slices with index greater than 5 are included. For OOD data, we extract 29,877 slices from single-coil knee MRI scans and 7,673 slices from prostate MRI scans. For evaluation, 20 images from the brain MRI validation set are used as the test set.

模型检查点。三个数据集的扩散模型都用 [15]（DDPM++，使用 EDM 预条件）在一块 NVIDIA A100 GPU 上训练。所有与 KL 散度有关的实验都在一块 NVIDIA RTX A6000 GPU 上完成。

English original
Model checkpoints. Diffusion models for all three datasets were trained using [15] (DDPM++ using EDM preconditioning) using one NVIDIA A100 GPU. All experiments regarding KL divergence were obtained using one NVIDIA RTX A6000 GPU.

测量模型。我们沿用 [54, 45] 的 MRI 测量设定来生成受损数据。测量算子 H\mathbf{H}H 沿频率（读出）轴做部分傅里叶采样，加速因子为 RRR。具体地，H\mathbf{H}H 保留最低的 120/R120/R120/R 个频率分量，再从其余频谱中随机选取额外的 200/R200/R200/R 个频率，从而在 320320320 条线中总共保留 320/R320/R320/R 条。该算子可以写成 H=IΣF\mathbf{H}=\boldsymbol{I}\boldsymbol{\Sigma}\boldsymbol{F}H=IΣF，其中 F\boldsymbol{F}F 表示离散傅里叶变换，Σ\boldsymbol{\Sigma}Σ 是编码采样模式的对角二叉矩阵。这一表示构成 H\mathbf{H}H 的一个合法 SVD，并可用 FFT 高效实现。H\mathbf{H}H 的结构满足我们的理论假设：它在推断时已知，其右奇异向量是 F\boldsymbol{F}F 且在所有样本间共享（满足假设 2）；固定低频采样与随机高频选择相结合，保证跨样本观测到的频率分量之并覆盖整个信号空间（满足假设 1）。

English original
Measurement model. We followed the MRI measurement setup from [54, 45] to create the corrupted data. The measurement operator H performs partial Fourier sampling along the frequency (readout) axis, with an acceleration factor R. Specifically, H retains the lowest 120/R frequency components and randomly selects an additional 200/R frequencies from the remaining spectrum, yielding a total of 320/R retained lines out of 320. The operator can be expressed as H = IΣF, where F denotes the discrete Fourier transform and Σ is a diagonal binary matrix encoding the sampling pattern. This representation serves as a valid SVD of H and can be efficiently implemented via FFT. The structure of H satisfies our theoretical assumptions: it is known at inference time, its right-singular vectors are F and shared across all samples (satisfying Assumption 2), and the combination of fixed low-frequency sampling with randomized high-frequency selection ensures that the union of observed frequency components across samples covers the full signal space (satisfying Assumption 1).

E.3 GMM 上的 KL 散度实验

English original
E.3 KL divergence experiments on GMMs

为了在不同噪声层级与部分观测下可视化并验证分布之间的 KL 散度估计，我们在 101010 维空间中用高斯混合模型（GMM）设计了一个合成设定。InD 与 OOD 都定义为具有 K=3K=3K=3 个分量的 GMM，每个分量权重相同、协方差为各向同性高斯。InD 分布的各分量均值被安排成 R10\mathbb{R}^{10}R10 前两个主维度上的一个结构化三角形布局：分量均值沿 x 轴以 555 个单位为间隔排布，并在 y 方向上交替偏移以造成分离。具体来说，InD 的均值定义为 [0,0,0,…][0,0,0,\ldots][0,0,0,…]、[5,5,0,…][5,5,0,\ldots][5,5,0,…]、[10,0,0,…][10,0,0,\ldots][10,0,0,…]，其余八个维度取零。所有 InD 分量共享相同的协方差矩阵，取 10×1010\times 1010×10 单位阵，从而在所有方向上都是各向同性的扩散。

English original
To visualize and validate KL divergence estimation between distributions under varying noise levels and partial observations, we designed a synthetic setup using Gaussian mixture models (GMMs) in a 10-dimensional space. Both the InD and OOD were defined as GMMs with K = 3 components, each having equal weights and isotropic Gaussian covariances. The component means of the InD distribution were arranged to form a structured triangular configuration in the first two principal dimensions of R10: component means were placed along the x-axis with offsets of 5 units, while alternating vertically in the y-direction to create separation. Specifically, the InD means were defined as [0, 0, 0, …], [5, 5, 0, …], [10, 0, 0, …], with the remaining eight dimensions set to zero. All InD components shared identical covariance matrices, set to the 10 × 10 identity matrix, yielding isotropic spreads in all directions.

为构造 OOD 分布，每个 InD 分量均值在前两个维度上被平移：沿 x 轴 101010 个单位、沿 y 轴 −5-5−5 个单位。这使得 OOD 分量中心明显偏离其 InD 对应物：[10,−5,0,…][10,-5,0,\ldots][10,−5,0,…]、[15,0,0,…][15,0,0,\ldots][15,0,0,…]、[20,−5,0,…][20,-5,0,\ldots][20,−5,0,…]。OOD 分量的协方差矩阵同样是各向同性的，且与 InD 情形相同。这一设定保证 InD 与 OOD 分布之间唯一的差别在于位置，从而可以在没有形状或扩散范围等混杂因素的情况下，干净地评估分布偏移。

English original
To construct the OOD distribution, each InD component mean was shifted in the first two dimensions: 10 units along the x-axis and −5 units along the y-axis. This resulted in OOD component centers that were clearly displaced from their InD counterparts: [10, −5, 0, …], [15, 0, 0, …], [20, −5, 0, …]. Covariance matrices for the OOD components were again isotropic and identical to the InD case. This setup ensures that the only difference between InD and OOD distributions lies in their location, allowing for a clean assessment of distributional shift without confounding factors such as varying shape or spread.

我们用相应公式、对 σ∈[0.01,1.0]\sigma\in[0.01,1.0]σ∈[0.01,1.0] 做黎曼和，分别在数据域与测量域近似 KL 散度度量。在测量受损的情形下，我们按给定概率对数据施加随机屏蔽，把相应元素置零以模拟缺失观测（例如类似修复）。然后我们在屏蔽数据上计算同样的基于分数的 KL，并与全数据 KL 比较。图 2 的可视化包含 InD 与 OOD 样本在前两个维度上的二维 PCA 投影，显示出清晰的空间分离。我们的结果表明，由部分观测（屏蔽）数据算出的 KL 散度，对不同的修复概率 ppp 与用于计算 KL 度量的样本数 NNN，都紧密跟踪由干净数据算出的散度。

English original
We approximated the KL divergence metrics both in data and measurement domain using the corresponding formulas using a Riemann sum over σ ∈ [0.01, 1.0]. In a measurement-corrupted scenario, we applied random masking to the data with a given probability, zeroing out entries to simulate missing observations (e.g., similar to inpainting). We then computed the same score-based KL on the masked data and compared it to the full-data KL. Visualizations in Figure 2 include PCA projections of the InD and OOD samples in 2D, showing clear spatial separation in the first two dimensions. Our results show that the KL divergence computed from partially observed (masked) data closely tracks the divergence computed from clean data for various inpainting probablity p and number of samples used for KL metric computing N.

English original
Theorem 1 provides the metric above for measuring distribution shift in term of KL divergence computed only on measurement data. We update the OOD model by minimizing the loss in Eq. (31) on the limited corrupted projected measurements from the InD distribution.

训练沿用 [15] 中扩散模型的训练方案（DDPM++，使用 EDM 预条件），不改变参数（只根据所用受损测量的数量调整批次数）。每个批次使用相同的修复 / MRI 掩膜。适配在一块 NVIDIA RTX A6000 GPU 上完成。适配的数据准备遵循与计算 KL 散度相同的过程，见 E.1 与 E.2 节。适配在满足下列条件之一时终止：(i) 训练损失在最近 10 kimg10\,\text{kimg}10kimg 内的改善不足 0.5%0.5\%0.5%；(ii) 已处理 BBB kimg（646464 条测量时 B=500B=500B=500，128128128 条时 B=1000B=1000B=1000）。

English original
The training follows the training for diffusion models from [15] (DDPM++ using EDM preconditioning), without changing the parameters (only batch number was adjusted based on the number of corrupted measurements used). For each batch, same inpainting/MRI mask was used. Adaptation was done using one NVIDIA RTX A6000 GPU. Data-prepartion for the adaptation follows the same procedure for calculating the KL divergence, noted in Sections E.1 and E.2. Adaptation is terminated when (i) the training loss fails to improve by ≥ 0.5% over the last 10 kimg, or (ii) B kimg have been processed (B = 500 for 64 measurements, B = 1000 for 128).

Figure 7 extends our evaluation to the MRI measurements using different subsampling masks, comparing the KL divergence—computed from clean brain MRI slices—with our measurement-domain KL metric, using only undersampled k-space measurements. English original
Figure 8 demonstrates the effect of model adaptation on reducing distribution shift in the MRI setting. We plot the KL divergence between Brain and Prostate MRI slices, both before and after adapting the OOD model using only 64 projected (corrupted) measurements. Results are shown for an acceleration rate of R = 4, with KL evaluated in both the image domain (dashed) and measurement domain (solid). As shown, adaptation using only projected measurements substantially reduces the KL divergence, confirming the effectiveness of our adaptation strategy in bridging the distributional gap without requiring clean images.

表 3 报告了在不同加速倍率 R∈{4,6,8}R\in\{4,6,8\}R∈{4,6,8} 与测量噪声层级 σz∈{0.0,0.1,0.2}\sigma_{\boldsymbol{z}}\in\{0.0,0.1,0.2\}σz​∈{0.0,0.1,0.2} 下，脑部（InD）与前列腺（OOD）MRI 分布之间的 KL 散度。最右列是在图像域计算的 KL 散度。在所有设定下，测量域 KL 估计都保持稳定并紧贴图像域的值，说明我们的度量对欠采样与高水平测量噪声都是稳健的。

English original
Table 3 reports the KL divergence between Brain (InD) and Prostate (OOD) MRI distributions under varying acceleration rates R ∈ {4, 6, 8} and measurement noise levels σ_z ∈ {0.0, 0.1, 0.2}. The most right column shows the KL divergence computed in the image domain. Across all settings, the measurement-domain KL estimates remain stable and closely match the image-domain value, demonstrating the robustness of our metric to both subsampling and high levels of measurement noise.
